description: Second diagram on page 456 (TRF(CW)-28), paired with WO-EXP-PRI x VT-PLT above. TR-INFO (transformation-information) upper-left, EXB-G-OR (establishing general order) upper-center as bridging upper chain. AFI (affinity insight) upper-right, SCI-DY (scientific dynamics), EXT-FT (extended functionalism), PART (participation) on the right. POL-DY (political dynamics) left, APL-DT (applied dictates) center. LK-IMP (linkage implication), PRI-INFO (principle information), SPT-DY (spectacle dynamics), INFO-DE(B) (black information descent) on lower chain.
